jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lindy
Our mission is to free humanity from work. We're starting by building an AI employee, not another tool people have to operate.
Lindy is like any other teammate: it joins your Slack, can be @-mentioned for help about anything, uses all your tools, and even builds its own if needed. It already saves countless hours to grateful teams who could no longer imagine working without it.

Our Culture
Lindy's Culture: https://app.notion.com/p/lindyai/Lindy-s-Culture-8f24be7f619a4e4aa7e93ba02d58cf4c

You can expect an environment with little process and high empowerment, paired with high expectations and a strong sense of urgency. We're a small team of smart, intense people dedicated to doing the best work of our lives.

We are an in-office company, working from our downtown San Francisco office 4+ days a week. We sponsor visas and cover relocation costs up to $20,000.

The Role
We're looking for someone to own engineering at Lindy.
We build a genuinely complex product: an agent that acts on real people's email, calendars, meetings, and company data, where being wrong has consequences.
You'll own the operating system and delivery: how work gets planned, reviewed, shipped, and kept running, plus the reliability bar, hiring, and standards. You'll report to the CEO and partner closely with our Senior Engineering Manager, our engineers, and product.
This is a builder's job. You'll still read code, review PRs, occasionally write them, and make architecture calls.

Key Responsibilities
Own engineering execution. Planning cadence, prioritization, and delivery. We must ship!
Build the operating system. On-call that works, CI that's fast, fast code reviews, clean project handoffs, incident response, and a standup and review cadence people actually get value from.
Own reliability. Our agent's reliability is the company's top priority. You own driving it up, and the eval infrastructure and self-improvement loops that get it there.
Build an AI-native engineering organization. Engineering itself is being rewritten. You'll push agentic development, AI code review, and the internal tooling that lets a small team out-ship a large one, and you'll measure whether it's actually working.
Own hiring and onboarding. Raise the bar, run a tight process, and get new engineers productive and clear about their responsibilities.
Dive deep. Review code, weigh in on architecture, and keep enough context to have real opinions.

Who You Are
You've built the machine before. You've led a 10-30 person engineering organization at a startup and personally installed the processes that made it work. You can walk us through what was broken, what you changed, and what happened to cycle time and quality.
Player-coach. You're a strong engineer who chose to lead, and you haven't stopped being an engineer. You don't lead from a distance.
AI-pilled. You're not just excited about AI. You have rebuilt your own and your team's workflow around agents, and you have real opinions about what works and what is theater.
You hold a high bar. You create an intense environment to do great work. You give feedback frequently, quickly, kindly, and specifically.
You have backbone. The team is direct and will tell you when it disagrees. We want someone who brings data and holds the line when they think they're right.
You have taste for reliability. You've owned a production system where failures were visible to customers, and you know the difference between a system that mostly works and one that's rock solid.

Bonus Qualifications
Experience with LLM applications, agent infrastructure, or eval systems.
Background in SRE, production engineering, or developer experience.
Experience with products that are simultaneously consumer-grade in polish and B2B in requirements.
You've hired and grown engineers who went on to do great things.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range $260–$330k + significant equity.
Excellent health coverage.
$20K relocation assistance if currently outside of the Bay Area, and visa sponsorship.
High autonomy and direct collaboration with the founder.

Location
San Francisco office (downtown), 4+ days a week in office.

Founded in 1918, Kearfott Corporation, a global Aerospace and Defense supplier for over 100 years, is a leader in the design and manufacture of precision motion control products and inertial navigation components. Kearfott has a very long history of innovation and excellence and is the go-to brand for many of our global clients. Kearfott is trusted, respected, and plays a vital role in the success of America’s aerospace and defense industries. With over a century of expertise & experience, Kearfott is dedicated to providing quality, reliability, and cutting-edge technology to customers worldwide to meet their sea, land, air, and space navigation and guidance requirements.

We are looking for talented individuals who want to be part of a world-class workforce. Join Kearfott and become part of a company that is recognized for technical expertise and respected worldwide as a ‘full-service’ provider.

For more information, visit our website at www.kearfott.com

Vice President of Engineering

Role Overview

This role leads the engineering function to deliver mission-critical systems, products, and technologies that meet stringent technical, regulatory, and operational requirements. This role blends deep technical expertise with executive leadership to drive innovation, ensure compliance, and deliver on program objectives.

Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the company's mission, product roadmap, and defense/aerospace industry standards.
Program Oversight: Lead interdisciplinary design, development, testing, and sustainment of aerospace and defense systems, including hypersonic, UAV, satellite, or mission systems.
Technical Standards & Compliance: Establish and enforce engineering standards, design practices, and quality controls to meet regulatory and safety requirements.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team, including technical leads, systems engineers, and specialists.
Budget & Resource Management: Manage multi-million-dollar engineering budgets, forecasting, and cost control; allocate resources effectively.
Technology & Innovation: Evaluate and implement new technologies, tools, and infrastructure to improve performance, reliability, and scalability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, program, and business leaders to align engineering deliverables with strategic goals.
Risk & Compliance: Oversee disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and compliance planning for defense and aerospace programs.
Vendor & Partner Management: Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and external partners to ensure quality and timely delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Systems, or related discipline) required. Master's degree in Engineering and/or MBA preferred.
Experience: 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within the aerospace and defense industry, including demonstrated executive leadership developing and delivering complex, high-reliability aerospace and defense electronic systems. Experience including mission-critical avionics, inertial navigation, guidance, sensing, and precision electro-mechanical products supporting airborne, ground, maritime, missile, and space applications, highly preferred.
Technical Expertise: Extensive knowledge of complex defense electronics, embedded hardware and software, systems engineering, electronics integration, and full product lifecycle development from concept through production and sustainment. Experience with aerospace and defense standards including DO-178C, DO-254, AS9100, CMMI, MIL-STDs, ITAR, and other applicable U.S. Government contracting requirements.
Product Development: Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through the complete product lifecycle, including technology development, customer-funded programs, qualification, certification, production transition, manufacturing support, and product sustainment.
Manufacturing Partnership: Experience partnering with manufacturing operations to improve producibility, quality, reliability, and operational performance while supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), production transition, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Leadership & Communication: Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leadership, customers, and government stakeholders while effectively leading multidisciplinary organizations through growth and organizational change.
Analytical & Strategic Skills: Demonstrated ability to establish engineering strategy, assess technical and programmatic risk, prioritize technology investments, and make sound business decisions that balance technical excellence, customer requirements, schedule, cost and customer satisfaction.
Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance.
Travel 25% to 40%

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Guidance & Navigation systems, Inertial Navigation Systems (INS), Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), precision motion control, or other high-reliability aerospace and defense products.
Experience supporting airborne, missile, ground vehicle, maritime, or space programs.
Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), New Product Introduction (NPI), and Independent Research & Development (IRAD).
Experience supporting both development and production engineering organizations within a highly regulated aerospace and defense manufacturing environment.

Our near future is full of ambitious new goals, features, and products that will enable us to further improve how we provide service to our users and accelerate growth.

This role will partner with Product and GTM teams to define and execute our technical vision, strengthen engineering operations, and help shape the future of video communication and AI-powered learning experiences.

What you'll do:

Lead a high-performing Engineering organization across multiple product areas and platforms.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

You're perfect for this role if you:

Bring 12+ years of software engineering experience leading teams in high-growth SaaS or product-led technology companies.
Have worked in early-stage or growth-stage startups (fewer than 50 people) and thrive in environments that require ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.
Are a hands-on technical leader who stays close to the work, comfortable diving into architecture and code-level discussions to guide decisions and solve technical problems.
Are fluent in how AI is changing the software engineering craft — you've personally used AI coding tools and have driven adoption of AI-assisted workflows across a team
Have a strong foundation across modern web technologies, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and scalable architectures, with experience in end-to-end systems (frontend, backend, platform, infrastructure, and DevOps) using tools like TypeScript, React, Node.js, and GCP.
Possess a track record of building and scaling products used by millions of users, with deep expertise in system design, reliability, scalability, and security.
Can translate company strategy into clear technical direction and drive strong execution in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment.
Communicate effectively across all levels from engineers to executives balancing technical depth with clear, outcome-oriented storytelling.
Excel in ambiguity, moving quickly and decisively without sacrificing engineering quality.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for engineering and application development teams supporting firmwide legal and business capabilities across value streams.
Set technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and operationally sustainable.
Partner closely with IT, legal operations, and business stakeholders to translate business outcomes and value stream priorities into executable technology roadmaps and engineering delivery strategy, keeping a user experience and product value mindset at the forefront.
Lead engineering execution and continuous delivery of technology capabilities, balancing innovation, platform stability, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational excellence.
Collaborate across IT functions to improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, and increase engineering throughput and reliability.
Oversee engineering efforts across multiple product and platform workstreams, balancing innovation, operational stability, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
Establish and promote engineering best practices including automation, CI/CD, observability, resiliency, testing, reusable engineering capabilities, and operational readiness.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, consultant resources, and third-party development partners as applicable to the success of the service portfolio and deliverables.
Lead, develop, and retain engineering management and senior technical talent, including performance management and succession planning.
Establish governance, metrics, and reporting for engineering performance, platform health, technical debt, operational sustainability, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure compliance with firm security, risk, governance, privacy, and data protection standards across all engineering activities.
Partner with infrastructure, operations, SRE, and end-user support teams to ensure stable production operations and smooth lifecycle support for delivered capabilities.
Provides leadership to and manages a team of business professionals to include coaching, mentoring and professional development. Responsible for providing performance feedback on a regular basis.

Enterprise application architecture and modern development practices. Strategic planning and execution in complex environments. People leadership and organizational development. Financial and vendor management. Stakeholder partnership and executive communication. Risk management, security awareness, and operational excellence.

Master's Degree in Technology, business, or management‑related discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Company

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager for the backend team, you will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for building and maintaining systems that power our financial products. This is a hybrid technical leadership role: you'll set technical direction, stay hands-on, and grow the people on your team — not just manage delivery from a distance. You'll play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our foundational infrastructure and product architecture, with a clear path to greater scope as you and the team grow. This is a rare chance to join a fast-growing fintech startup where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on both the company and the financial well-being of our users.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction for the team — deciding what to build and how — in partnership with product managers and cross-functional leaders, aligning engineering efforts with business priorities.
Lead system design review, giving substantive, critical feedback that shapes how the team's architecture evolves.
Stay genuinely hands-on: write code regularly (not just review it), and step in to unblock the team or fill in for engineers when the situation calls for it, without hesitation.
Oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend services, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term goals.
Make thoughtful trade-offs between tech debt and feature delivery, maintaining system health while accelerating product impact.

People Leadership

Run consistent 1:1s, give direct and meaningful feedback, and build clear career development plans for each direct report.
Mentor and coach engineers to help them grow into stronger ICs and future leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and urgency on the team.

Operational Excellence

Promote engineering best practices with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and code quality.
Manage and continuously improve team processes — sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives — to drive effective collaboration and timely delivery.
Own incident response for your team's systems, including on-call participation.

What Success Looks Like

We're looking for someone who treats the role the way our strongest engineering managers do:

Bias toward building, not just overseeing. You'd rather write the code and review the design than just delegate it — hands-on work is a current habit, not a résumé line from a few years ago.
Low ego, high initiative. You notice broken processes and fix or flag them without being asked — you don't wait for permission to make things better.
Constructive with peers. You're comfortable challenging other engineering leads directly when something isn't working, not just within your own team.
All-in. This is a high-ownership, fast-paced environment, and we're looking for someone who wants that kind of intensity, not someone weighing it against a slower-paced alternative.

Requirements

3+ years of experience managing engineering teams of 5 or more
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with current, active coding involvement (roughly 20% of your time, or a clear desire to increase it)
Experience building and operating distributed, high-throughput, and mission-critical systems, ideally in financial services
Proven track record of leading teams to deliver complex projects
Experience mentoring engineers into future leaders and growing talent
Familiarity with incident management and on-call operations
Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments with a bias for action
Solid understanding of security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

Nice to Have

Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems and lending or cash advance products
Experience managing managers, or a clear track record of preparing for it

Benefits And Perks

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.

We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment.
Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.
401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting
Meal program available for both lunch and dinner
Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match
Life and accidental insurance
Flexible PTO

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

This position is in CMSD (Configurable Mixed-Signal Division), which is part of Renesas’ Analog & Mixed-Signal Product Group. The CMSD R&D team develops and industrializes highly configurable mixed-signal products for a wide range of applications, including but not limited to consumer, communication, computing, data center, industrial, and automotive applications. The CMSD team is the pioneer and dominant market leader of the highly successful GreenPAKTM family of products. These customer configurable products and platforms enable customers to differentiate their products, reduce BOM cost, and development cost and time. The CMSD team is continuously expanding the product portfolio that includes high-performance analog IP’s, DC-DC converters, and FPGA solutions.

As a Senior Manager Analog Engineering you will lead a team of analog designers and be the technical project lead for the development of our configurable mixed-signal ASICs. You will be responsible for all technical aspects of the project, from the initial concept phase through definition and architecture selection to design development, verification, and collaboration with cross-functional teams (test development, qualification etc.) to prepare the product for market release.

Job Description

Work with the product definition and marketing team to develop a specification that gives the product a competitive advantage in the IC market
Develop the product’s system architecture to optimize performance, power, and die size
Specify the requirements of individual IPs used in the product
Work with the project manager to define a development plan for design, verification, and layout
Develop a comprehensive analog and mixed-signal verification plan
Lead a high-quality product development by ensuring that best practices are followed, through thorough peer reviews, and detailed documentation
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on test development, product engineering, bench evaluation, and quality assurance
Mentor and develop your team

Qualifications

MSEE + 15 years of experience in analog and mixed-signal design
Fully competent in all common aspects of analog design
Design experience in precision analog circuitry
Design experience in power management circuits and high voltage circuitry (BCD processes)
Ability to develop system architectures
Knowledge of analog circuit modeling and AMS simulations
Knowledge of all aspects of IC development beyond analog design to efficiently collaborate with cross-functional teams: understanding the basic digital design flow, packaging, test engineering, quality assurance, and product engineering
Ability to see the big picture while not losing track of details
Excellent communication skills to operate in a global environment
Coaching, mentoring, and development of team members

Additional Information

The expected annual pay range for this position is a base range of $225,000K - $275,000K. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Vacation: 12 to 25 days per year depending on the length of public sector employment.

Plans, organizes, directs, and oversees departmental information technology operations supporting approximately 400 devices and 350 users.

Oversees development and delivery of operational, analytical, and management reporting to support departmental functions and decision-making.
Evaluates business and regulatory requirements and directs development of new or enhanced software solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Oversees and supports IIS and SQL Server environments.
Develops and implements annual and long-term IT strategic plans aligned with departmental and County-wide objectives.
Establishes, maintains, and updates IT policies, procedures, and standards to ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to best practices.
Researches emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices and recommends system and process improvements.
Serves as technical consultant and departmental representative on County-wide committees, including the Santa Barbara County Data Sharing Committee.
Provides technical expertise, analysis, and recommendations for multi-departmental and enterprise initiatives, including CalAIM and Reentry Planning projects.

Education And Experience

Equivalent of a bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university in computer science, information technology, or related field; AND

The Senior Director, Insights Platform will support building and scaling the operating platform that powers FMG Leading’s proprietary insights capabilities as part of the broader enterprise platform. This role connects data, assessments, market intelligence, partner technologies, AI-enabled tools, and FMG Leading’s advisory expertise into practical workflows, outputs, and client-facing solutions that help leaders make better decisions and translate insights into measurable business outcomes. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on platform builder and operator role for someone who can move priority capabilities from concept into execution. The Insights Platform will operate as an integrated part of FMG Leading’s broader enterprise platform and will be informed by the firm’s advisory strategy, market priorities, commercial insight, and enterprise operating requirements. This role will bridge strategy and execution while maintaining clear boundaries among commercial input, advisory methodology, enterprise operations, and platform execution. The Senior Director will collaborate closely with EAS leadership, the CSO, consulting and commercial leaders, Enterprise Operations, IT/BIS, and external technology partners to create structure around how FMG Leading captures, governs, integrates, and applies its insights assets.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency, commercial context, business judgment, and advisory orientation. They should be comfortable translating business and advisory needs into data architecture, platform requirements, partner deliverables, governance practices, and scalable operating models. Over time, this role has potential to evolve into broader leadership of FMG Leading's insights platform and related technology-enabled advisory capabilities.

Core Accountabilities & Responsibilities

1. Insights Platform & Operating Model

Build and scale FMG Leading's Insights Platform to support FMG Leading’s advisory model, commercial strategy, and client delivery.
Collaborate with EAS leadership and the CSO to articulate and realize platform vision, guardrails, strategic choices, roadmap, and operating model.
Translate business priorities and advisory needs into platform capabilities, execution plans, and partner requirements.
Determine where capabilities should be built, partnered, integrated, or acquired.
Establish governance, operating mechanisms, and platform capabilities that enable disciplined execution.

2. Data Architecture, Management & Governance

Develop the data foundation that connects proprietary data, assessments, market intelligence, partner technologies, and internal systems.
Shape the data architecture, management approach, and governance standards associated with the Insights Platform, harmonized with the form, function, architecture, and operating requirements of FMG Leading’s broader enterprise platform.
Improve data quality, ownership, security, privacy, accessibility, usability and appropriate access controls across platform-related data assets.
Establish and maintain appropriate platform security, data privacy, access-control, and governance standards, including consideration of PHI/PII requirements where applicable.
Partner with IT/BIS and vendors on integrations, APIs, platform architecture, reporting infrastructure, and data flows.
Ensure insights assets are scalable, trusted, governed, and harmonized with the broader enterprise platform, systems, and operating standards.

3. Technology Partner Ecosystem

Coordinate FMG Leading's network of technology and insights partners so external capabilities become integrated, practical, and usable across the platform.
Align partner capabilities, workstreams, priorities, and dependencies with FMG's operating model and strategic guardrails.
Translate external technologies into practical advisory capabilities, workflows, and client-facing outputs.
Manage partner deliverables, dependencies, and integration points in collaboration with EAS leadership, Enterprise Operations, IT/BIS, and consulting teams.
Personally execute, document, troubleshoot, and drive work forward rather than only managing from a distance.

4. Insights Products & Advisory Enablement

Turn platform capabilities into repeatable offerings that improve client outcomes and enable teams to deliver them confidently.
Develop repeatable insights products, dashboards, tools, and client-facing solutions that support advisory delivery, informed by market dynamics and commercial input and shaped in partnership with EAS leadership.
Create playbooks, training, documentation, and enablement resources for PMs, client leads, and consulting teams.
Gather feedback from users and client-facing teams to continuously improve adoption, usability, and platform value.
Stay current on emerging AI, data, and technology developments to inform FMG Leading’s platform direction, advisory capabilities, and client-facing solutions.

Serve as a hands-on builder who connects strategy, operations, technology, and consulting teams while supporting practical AI and knowledge management capabilities where they intersect within the Insights Platform.

Simplify complex issues into clear recommendations, decision points, and action plans for leadership alignment.
Identify and support practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and client value within the Insights Platform, informed by and aligned with FMG Leading’s broader enterprise AI strategy.
Partner with Enterprise Operations and LT Value Creation to ensure responsible adoption, governance, and integration of platform-related AI and knowledge management capabilities remain aligned with broader firmwide priorities and enterprise platform direction.
Build alignment, remove obstacles, and help teams adopt platform-enabled ways of working.

Set technical direction for the team — deciding what to build and how — in partnership with product managers and cross-functional leaders, aligning engineering efforts with business priorities.
Lead system design review, giving substantive, critical feedback that shapes how the team's architecture evolves.

Oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend services, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term goals.

People Leadership

Bias toward building, not just overseeing. You'd rather write the code and review the design than just delegate it — hands-on work is a current habit, not a résumé line from a few years ago.

Experience managing managers, or a clear track record of preparing for it
